description: This Java class, SubscriptionEventAdapter, is an internal component of a software project responsible for mapping SubscriptionEvent objects to and from Adaptable representations, specifically for handling various subscription-related signals in a protocol adapter context.

classes.name: SubscriptionEventAdapter
classes.description: An internal final class that adapts SubscriptionEvent instances to and from an Adaptable representation suitable for protocol communication, handling various subscription signal types and mapping them accordingly.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SubscriptionEventAdapter with specified header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type prefix combined with the search action of the adaptable's topic path.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a SubscriptionEvent into an Adaptable, mapping based on event subtype and constructing appropriate topic paths and payload content.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria this adapter is interested in, specifically SEARCH.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set indicating this adapter does not handle specific actions.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is for responses (returns false).

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions this adapter handles, including COMPLETE, NEXT, FAILED, and GENERATED.
